subject: Evidence retention toggle and batch deletion waiver
messages:
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@mediwell.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence retention toggle and batch deletion waiver

Hi Sofia,

We have an external compliance audit scheduled for June that will require us to surface a set of historical 'evidence logs' and a small number of full backup snapshots covering 18 months. Our internal policy allows us to request exceptions, but we need to understand Redwood's ability to: 1) temporarily extend retention for a defined subset of data (tagged evidence) while leaving routine debug logs on standard purge schedules, and 2) put a one-off waiver in place to prevent automatic batch deletion during the audit window.

Specific asks:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can create a per-account conditional hold that applies only to objects with an evidence tag?
- What is the operational runbook to lift/re-apply such a hold?
- If we need a contract addendum (DPA) for retention beyond 12 months, can you start that process?
- Any impact on backup/export procedures or costs?

I've attached the audit scope (audit_scope.xlsx) so you can see the data sets. Legal is on copy for visibility.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Thompson
Sr. Compliance Manager, MediWell

Attachment: audit_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@mediwell.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence retention toggle and batch deletion waiver

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear scope and the attachment. Quick confirmation up front: we can scope a conditional hold to tagged objects at the account level and we can implement a temporary waiver for scheduled batch purges. There are a few implementation tradeoffs and approvals needed (see below).

Proposal (high-level):
- Conditional hold: Create an "evidence" retention tag. Objects with this tag will be excluded from the automated purge job. Hold can be set to an explicit start and end date.
- Waiver window: For perf/debug logs older than 90 days we recommend keeping standard purge — unless the customer explicitly flags additional logs.
- Snapshot exports: Full backup snapshots requested for audit will be exported to a dedicated, encrypted archive bucket (KMS-managed) and retained per the addendum.

Operational notes / dependencies:
- Legal DPA addendum if retention > 12 months (Kimberly — can you confirm required language?).
- Security controls: we will restrict access to exported snapshots to a narrow IAM role and generate audit logs for each access event.
- Automation: Marcus will confirm whether we can automate the tag->hold lifecycle or whether it needs manual runbook initiation for the first audit.

Next steps (actionable):
1) Kimberly to draft DPA addendum language and confirm sign-off path (target: EOD 2027-04-06).
2) Marcus to validate automation feasibility and share a proposed schedule and cost estimate (target: 2027-04-20).
3) Monica (CS) will coordinate billing impacts and any temporary charge credits for export/storage during the audit window.
4) I'll schedule a 30-min call next week to walk through the technical flow and permissions.

Attaching a brief proposed criteria doc for the waiver to make it easier to iterate: proposed-waiver-criteria.docx

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-waiver-criteria.docx (document, 12KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@mediwell.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence retention toggle and batch deletion waiver

Thanks for the context. From a legal/compliance standpoint:

- If MediWell requests retention longer than our standard 12 months for exported audit evidence, we should execute a narrow DPA addendum that: (a) lists the specific data classes and retention period, (b) requires customer approval before re-applying automated purges, and (c) confirms encryption and access controls.
- I'll prepare a redline addendum with minimal, audit-scoped language to avoid broad contract exposure.
- We should include a clause that the waiver is time-limited and can be revoked if misuse is detected.

Risks & mitigations:
- Increased retention increases discovery surface — mitigation: strict role-based access and privileged access monitoring.
- Cross-border transfer considerations if any snapshots are stored in regions outside the customer's control — mitigation: ensure the archive bucket location aligns with MediWell's data residency constraints or get express consent.

I'll upload a redline and a DocuSign envelope for signature. Link will follow in my next message.

Attachment: dpa-addendum-redline.pdf (pdf, 6KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@mediwell.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 14:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence retention toggle and batch deletion waiver (technical details)

Hi all — technical details and what we can deliver without infra changes: 

1) Current purge cadence (existing): daily incremental roll-forward; weekly full snapshot retention for 180 days; debug logs pruned at 90 days.
2) Proposed audit flow:
   - Create evidence tag and a job that excludes tagged objects from the daily purge.
   - Export requested full snapshots to a secure archive bucket that we can retain for up to 730 days (per customer's request). Archive bucket will be KMS-encrypted and access-controlled.
   - Generate object-level audit events and a separate access log retention for 2 years.

3) Automation vs manual runbook:
   - Minimal viable: manual runbook to add/remove evidence tags and flip the exclusion flag (can be done by our ops team).
   - Preferred: add tag-based automation that runs once and then auto-expires the hold at the end date. That requires a small scheduler job and tagging API change (estimated 2w dev effort + QA).

4) Cost considerations:
   - Archive storage and additional access logging will incur incremental monthly costs. I'll provide an estimate if you confirm snapshot size.

I'll attach the internal retention runbook excerpt for the manual path; it includes exact CLI commands and the access-control checklist.

Attachment: retention-playbook.md (markdown, 9KB)

Let me know if you want me to prototype the automation on a non-prod account first.

— Marcus

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@mediwell.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence retention toggle and batch deletion waiver — agreed next steps

Sarah — summarizing decisions & next steps so we have a single place to track: 

1) Scope & retention: Redwood will implement an account-scoped "evidence" tag and exclude tagged objects from the automated purge for the agreed audit window. Exported snapshots (per audit scope) will be retained in an encrypted archive for up to 730 days pending DPA addendum approval.
2) Legal: Kimberly will circulate a redline DPA addendum via DocuSign for MediWell signature (target: EOD 2027-04-06).
3) Automation: Marcus will validate automation feasibility and provide a dev/QA timeline and a non-prod prototype plan (target: 2027-04-20). If timeline is tight, we will perform the first audit run via manual ops runbook.
4) Billing: Monica (cc'd) will estimate incremental storage/export costs and propose whether we issue a temporary credit for export operations.
5) Audit access: We will provide object-level access logs and require MediWell to provide a list of approvers who can request re-application of purges after the window closes.

Please confirm you are comfortable with this plan and we will proceed to the Docusign step. If you want a short working session to walk through the retention-playbook, I can schedule 30 minutes on Wednesday.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

Cc: Monica Patel (Customer Success)

Attachment references: audit_scope.xlsx, proposed-waiver-criteria.docx, dpa-addendum-redline.pdf, retention-playbook.md
